name: Panax Red Ginseng
summary: Red ginseng has moderate human evidence for fatigue and modest erectile-function outcomes, with product processing affecting ginsenoside profile.
description: Processed Panax ginseng preparation with altered ginsenoside composition compared with white ginseng.
safetyNotes: Insomnia and headache; possible hypoglycemia and interactions including warfarin.
evidenceLevel: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
contraindications: Uncontrolled hypertension or acute infection or nosebleeds or heavy menstrual bleeding
may reduce the anticoagulant effect of warfarin based on case reports and ginsenoside antagonism studies
concurrent MAOI antidepressants such as phenelzine carry case reports of manic-like overstimulation
may potentiate insulin or oral diabetes medication through additive blood-sugar-lowering activity
pregnancy or breastfeeding without clinician guidance due to limited safety data.
evidence_tier: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
evidenceTier: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
